summary: Frontend testing of e-Konut module: /toki search page and /toki/{id} project detail page (ProjectDetailPage.js). All 10 test scenarios executed and PASSED. AdaParselView syntax fix confirmed working. All stat cards, gallery banner, progress bar, tabs, YouTube embeds, and OpenLayers map all render correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Ada/Parsel tab shows 'Bu projede ada/parsel bilgisi bulunmuyor.' for the test project - this is expected if no ada/parsel records exist in DB for this project. The AdaParselView component handles the empty state correctly.
Belgeler tab shows 'Bu proje icin henuz belge eklenmemis.' - no documents for test project. Expected empty state.

The getProjectPath() function in TOKISearchPage.js routes projects with project_type to /project/{id} and without to /toki/{id}. This dual routing may cause confusion - should be tested if all projects navigate to the correct route.
VideoCard and VideosView both define local getYoutubeId/getYouTubeId functions separately. Minor code DRY violation but no functional impact.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Used existing test project '1. Bölge 1. Etap' (f70c57f6-28a6-4dbd-a4d3-5ea8e4bce6a6).
